title: Dialog 심화 문제

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ④. 지갑을 추천받았으므로 추천을 요청하는 말이 온다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 01)
questions.promptEn:
01 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

A: I'm looking for a gift for my friend.
B: How about this wallet? It's in great condition and very popular.
A: ______
choices: I like both of them.
Which do you prefer, music or math?
My favorite gift is a colored pencil set.
Could you recommend something for her?
Do you prefer buying things online or offline?

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ④. 간식 추천 요청에 다른 것을 먹고 싶다고 한 응답은 어색하다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 02)
questions.promptEn: 02 다음 중 짝지어진 대화가 어색한 것은?
choices:
A: Which do you like more, the slippers or the sandals?
B: I like the slippers more.

A: What do you recommend for souvenirs?
B: How about this bookmark set?

A: Which food do you recommend for me?
B: I recommend tteokbokki. It's really good.

A: What will you recommend for snack?
B: I want to try something else.

A: Which do you prefer, hamburgers or chicken?
B: I prefer hamburgers to chicken.

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ②. ⓐ와 ② 모두 우산보다 시계를 선호한다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 03)
questions.promptEn:
03 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ와 의미가 같은 것은?

A: I have a watch and an umbrella for sale.
B: Oh, I like both. But I can only buy one.
A: I see. Which one do you prefer?
B: <u>ⓐI prefer the watch.</u> How much is it?
A: It's 5,000 won, but I can give you a 10 percent discount.
B: Great! I'll take it.
choices: I want to buy both of them.
I like the watch better than the umbrella.
I think the umbrella is better than the watch.
I prefer the umbrella to the watch.
I like the watch as much as the umbrella.

questions.ruleKo: 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만, 문장 문제는 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 빈칸이나 문장을 쓰시오. 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만, 문장 문제는 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: watch, 500-won. 시계를 사고, 10퍼센트 할인은 500원이다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 04)
questions.promptEn:
04 위 대화를 읽고, 질문에 대한 답을 완성하시오.

A: I have a watch and an umbrella for sale.
B: Oh, I like both. But I can only buy one.
A: I see. Which one do you prefer?
B: <u>ⓐI prefer the watch.</u> How much is it?
A: It's 5,000 won, but I can give you a 10 percent discount.
B: Great! I'll take it.

Q. Which item is the boy going to buy and how much is the discount for the item?
He's going to buy the ______ at a ______ discount.
accept: He's going to buy the watch at a 500-won discount.
He's going to buy the watch at a 500 won discount.

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ④. 추천 요청 다음에 꽃무늬 가방을 제안한다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 05)
questions.promptEn:
05 위 대화의 ①~⑤ 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

How about the one with the flower on it?

G: Hello. I'd like to buy a bag. ①
M: Okay. We have two colors, white and black. Which do you prefer?
G: I prefer white to black.
M: ② Then you can choose between these two bags.
G: They both look nice. ③
M: ④ It's popular with our customers.
G: ⑤ That looks good. I'll take that one.
choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤

questions.ruleKo: 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만, 문장 문제는 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 빈칸이나 문장을 쓰시오. 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만, 문장 문제는 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: Can you recommend one for me? (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 06)
questions.promptEn:
06 위 대화의 ③에 있는 우리말 뜻을 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.
조건 1. can, for, me를 포함하여 쓸 것.
조건 2. 총 6단어의 완전한 문장으로 쓸 것.
우리말: 저한테 하나 추천해 주시겠어요?

G: Hello. I'd like to buy a bag.
M: Okay. We have two colors, white and black. Which do you prefer?
G: I prefer white to black.
M: Then you can choose between these two bags.
G: They both look nice. ③ 저한테 하나 추천해 주시겠어요?
M: How about the one with the flower on it? It's popular with our customers.
G: That looks good. I'll take <u>ⓑthat one</u>.
accept: Can you recommend one for me?

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ④. 소녀는 흰색을 고르고, 점원이 꽃무늬를 추천했으며, 소녀가 그것을 산다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 07)
questions.promptEn:
07 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓑ가 가리키는 것은?

G: Hello. I'd like to buy a bag.
M: Okay. We have two colors, white and black. Which do you prefer?
G: I prefer white to black.
M: Then you can choose between these two bags.
G: They both look nice. Can you recommend one for me?
M: How about the one with the flower on it? It's popular with our customers.
G: That looks good. I'll take <u>ⓑthat one</u>.
choices: the black bag
two white bags
all bags in the store
the white bag with a flower
the black bag with a flower

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ③. 소녀는 검은색보다 흰색 가방을 더 좋아한다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 08)
questions.promptEn:
08 According to the dialog, which one is NOT true?

G: Hello. I'd like to buy a bag.
M: Okay. We have two colors, white and black. Which do you prefer?
G: I prefer white to black.
M: Then you can choose between these two bags.
G: They both look nice. Can you recommend one for me?
M: How about the one with the flower on it? It's popular with our customers.
G: That looks good. I'll take <u>ⓑthat one</u>.
choices: The girl wants to buy a bag at the store.
The store has two different colors for the bags.
The girl likes the black bag more than the white one.
The clerk recommends a bag that is popular with customers.
The girl finally decides to buy only one bag.

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ③ shoes. 진호는 신발을 사려고 한다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 09)
questions.promptEn:
09 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

G: Hi, Jinho! What are you doing?
B: Hi, Minji! I'm trying to buy ⓐ ______ online. Can you help me?
G: Sure! Hmm... There are sneakers and boots. Which do you prefer?
B: ⓑ ______ Can you recommend one?
G: How about sneakers? They go well with all kinds of clothes.
B: That's true! <u>ⓒWhat size should I choose?</u>
G: I think the black ones look better.
B: That sounds good! I'll buy them then. Thanks for your help!
choices: a bag
a cap
shoes
pants
an umbrella

questions.explainKo: 정답: ⑤. 둘 다 좋아서 결정을 못 한다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 10)
questions.promptEn:
10 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

G: Hi, Jinho! What are you doing?
B: Hi, Minji! I'm trying to buy ⓐ ______ online. Can you help me?
G: Sure! Hmm... There are sneakers and boots. Which do you prefer?
B: ⓑ ______ Can you recommend one?
G: How about sneakers? They go well with all kinds of clothes.
B: That's true! <u>ⓒWhat size should I choose?</u>
G: I think the black ones look better.
B: That sounds good! I'll buy them then. Thanks for your help!
choices: I don't like both.
I already bought sneakers.
I prefer boots to sneakers.
I like sneakers better than boots.
I like both, so I can't decide.

questions.promptEn:
11 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓒ에서 문맥상 어색한 곳을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 문장을 다시 쓰시오. 단어의 수는 같게 쓸 것.

G: Hi, Jinho! What are you doing?
B: Hi, Minji! I'm trying to buy ⓐ ______ online. Can you help me?
G: Sure! Hmm... There are sneakers and boots. Which do you prefer?
B: ⓑ ______ Can you recommend one?
G: How about sneakers? They go well with all kinds of clothes.
B: That's true! <u>ⓒWhat size should I choose?</u>
G: I think the black ones look better.

questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ②. 민지가 진호의 신발 고르기를 돕고 있다. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 12)
questions.promptEn:
12 What are the speakers mainly talking about?

G: Hi, Jinho! What are you doing?
B: Hi, Minji! I'm trying to buy shoes online. Can you help me?
G: Sure! Hmm... There are sneakers and boots. Which do you prefer?
B: I like both, so I can't decide. Can you recommend one?
G: How about sneakers? They go well with all kinds of clothes.
B: That's true! What color should I choose?
G: I think the black ones look better.
B: That sounds good! I'll buy them then. Thanks for your help!
choices: Jinho is teaching Minji how to buy shoes.
Minji is helping Jinho choose which shoes to buy.
Jinho and Minji are talking about their favorite colors.
Minji is asking Jinho to recommend some sneakers.
Jinho is explaining why sneakers are better than boots.

questions.ruleKo: 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만, 문장 문제는 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 빈칸이나 문장을 쓰시오. 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만, 문장 문제는 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: they go well with all kinds of clothes. (답지 p.27 Dialog 심화 문제 13)
questions.promptEn:
13 위 대화를 읽고, 질문에 대한 답을 조건에 맞게 완성하시오.
조건 1. 대화문에 쓰인 표현을 이용할 것.
조건 2. Because 다음에 총 8단어로 쓸 것.

G: Hi, Jinho! What are you doing?
B: Hi, Minji! I'm trying to buy shoes online. Can you help me?
G: Sure! Hmm... There are sneakers and boots. Which do you prefer?
B: I like both, so I can't decide. Can you recommend one?
G: How about sneakers? They go well with all kinds of clothes.
B: That's true! What color should I choose?
G: I think the black ones look better.
B: That sounds good! I'll buy them then. Thanks for your help!

Q. Why does Minji recommend sneakers to Jinho?
Because ______
accept: they go well with all kinds of clothes

introKo: 통과 80%. Dialog 심화 문제. 고르기는 누르고, 서술형은 답만 쓰시오.
